# vcp_vmware_storage_profiles (Data Source)

List available VMware Cloud storage profiles.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vcp_vmware_storage_profiles" "ssd" {
  location_id  = 5
  disk_type_id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `disk_type_id` (Number) Filter storage profiles by disk type ID.
- `location_id` (Number) Filter storage profiles by location ID.

### Read-Only

- `storage_profiles` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--storage_profiles))

<a id="nestedatt--storage_profiles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `storage_profiles`

Read-Only:

- `disk_type_id` (Number)
- `free_space_gb` (Number)
- `id` (Number)
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `name` (String)
